At recursive calls, C\\{c} need not be a member of F_c, so a transversal of F_c may be disjoint from it; the claimed inheritance does not justify applying the induction hypothesis to all transversals.","quote":"Every transversal $X$ of $\\mathcal F$ meets $C$, since $C$ itself is a member of $\\mathcal F$ whenever this assertion is applied below"}],"notes":"The pairwise-gcd observation, increasing-enumeration argument, and final periodicity deduction are correct conditional on finite generation.
